useWhen: Check or explain a CircleCI config.yml the operator holds, show which jobs a branch or tag would run and in what order, produce the processed config or API v2 shapes, or summarize CircleCI run records and JUnit reports the operator downloaded
avoidWhen: Running a job, triggering a pipeline, reading from circleci.com or a VCS, resolving orbs, or presenting kumitate's plan as CircleCI's own result

inputs.branch_tag: the branch or tag the pipeline is for, and pipeline parameter values
inputs.text: run records: CircleCI API v2 items pages or kumitate.runs.v1 JSON
inputs.reports: JUnit XML texts, one a run

outputs.check: valid, errors and warnings with named codes (yaml/, config/, plan/, expr/, regex/)
outputs.plan: workflows that run, job levels, parallel jobs and containers, skipped jobs with reasons
outputs.api: Pipeline, Workflow and Job objects in the API v2 shape
outputs.summary: status counts, failed jobs, success rate and mean duration per job, flaky jobs and tests, slowest tests

authority.binding: caller-authorized profile mcp_servers entry pointing at a server the owner started, and an owner-reviewed effective tool allowlist

validation.runtime: protocol-tested 2026-10-23: tools/list and tools/call (kumitate_plan) over Streamable HTTP with the itonami-agent HTTP MCP client (kotoba-lang/itonami-agent 0c05574, src/itonami/agent/mcp_http_client.mjs) against the native aarch64-linux image in podman; curl checks of 405, 403, 404 and 202; the Kotoba gate 18/18 and fixture selftest 75/75 on aarch64-linux and x86_64-linux (docs/evidence/kotoba-selfhost-gate-20261023.edn); no model-driven agent turn, no deployed profile

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only. itonami-agent exposes the tools as mcp__kumitate__<tool>. The server is a loaderless static image; the owner starts it with KEXE_ALLOW=37,38,39,43,44,46,47 and KEXE_CAP_RESOURCES_43 naming the one address it may listen on. No stdio transport yet (kotoba-lang/amu#1516). Format and semantics compatibility only; no connection to circleci.com.
requires: Owner-built kumitate native image (README "Kotoba gate", amu selfhost root 1739f52f...) on aarch64-linux or x86_64-linux, or in an arm64/amd64 Linux VM
The owner starting `kumitate serve 127.0.0.1:8787` with the listen grant

launchResolution.behavior: The server is not launched by the client. The owner starts it on a loopback address of their choice and writes that address as the url of the profile's mcp_servers entry; only POST /mcp is served, and a non-localhost Origin is refused.
